patch.value: Reproducible workspace instances: seeded identifiers, injectable clock, and byte-identical construction from a declared recipe

Two runs of the same script against a fresh pm workspace produce different data. Identifiers are random, timestamps are wall-clock, and history entry hashes chain over both, so nothing downstream of a workspace can be compared byte for byte across runs. That blocks four things at once: golden-file testing of anything that emits ids or times, reproducible benchmark corpora at the scales the scale-out programme targets, deterministic training and evaluation episodes, and the strongest form of the reconstruction guarantee, namely that a recorded stream replays to a bit-identical workspace on a different machine years later. The primitive is small and self-contained: allow a workspace to be constructed with a declared seed and a declared clock so that identifier generation and timestamping become pure functions of the recipe, and make the recipe itself a recorded artifact. Determinism is opt-in and off by default, so real tracking is unaffected. Fences: pm-a8lnoh owns seeded interleavings for testing pm's own races and would consume this rather than duplicate it; pm-wlqxg3 owns proving that an existing stream replays to the recorded state, which is replay of real history rather than construction from a seed; pm-z71aoy needs representative corpora and is the immediate beneficiary; pm-khdq is the identifier allocation race, which is a correctness bug in the current generator rather than a determinism feature.

A workspace can be constructed from a declared recipe consisting of a seed, a clock and an operation sequence, and two constructions from the same recipe are byte-identical including identifiers, timestamps and history hashes; determinism is opt-in and the default behaviour of real workspaces is unchanged; the recipe is a first-class artifact that can be stored, shared and re-executed by a different machine and a different pm build within the supported format window; the benchmark and token-budget corpora are generated from recipes rather than committed fixtures; the deterministic path is exercised in CI, and a deliberate nondeterminism regression fails it; the clock injection is total, so no code path reads wall-clock time directly when a clock is supplied
